RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias—just as an all-men panel would not be. Your qualifications justify asking how the criteria were applied, but publication counts and PhD status do not capture teaching quality, interview performance, subject fit, or relevant industry experience.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and whether a completed PhD was mandatory. Check the university’s panel-composition rules and complaint deadlines.

Raise panel composition neutrally if it breached those rules; allege discrimination only with additional supporting evidence. Two weeks’ silence alone does not establish bias.
